exam_price_notes: Varies by training mode (iLearn, iWeek, or training partner). Visit the official EC-Council website for pricing details.

testing_centers.notes: Online proctored via EC-Council's own portal
In-person at Pearson VUE authorized test centers

id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID with full name and photo. ID must match the name used during registration.
exam_rules: No notes, books, or electronic devices. No internet access during exam. Scratch paper may be provided. Proctor monitors via webcam.
renewal_options: Earn 120 ECE (EC-Council Continuing Education) credits over 3-year cycle. ECE credits earned through courses, conferences, publications, or EC-Council activities.
target_audience: IT/forensics professionals with a basic understanding of IT/cybersecurity, computer forensics, and incident response.
recommended_experience: Basic knowledge of IT/cybersecurity, computer forensics, and incident response.

retake_policy.notes: No official waiting period specified between retakes. Full exam fee required for each retake.

objectives.title: Fundamentals of Computer Forensics
sub_objectives: Understand the scope of computer forensics
Understand the role of digital evidence
Understand forensic readiness and business continuity
Understand the incident response process flow
Understand the role of artificial intelligence in computer forensics
Understand the roles and responsibilities of a forensic investigator
Understand the challenges posed by cybercrimes to investigators
Understand computer forensics and legal compliance

objectives.title: Forensic Investigation Process and its Importance
sub_objectives: Understand the phases involved in the computer forensics investigation process
Understand the roles of first responders
Understand first response in different situations
Understand how to set up a computer forensics lab
Understand hardware and software requirements for a forensics lab
Understand how to build security content, scripts, tools, or methods to enhance forensic processes
Understand how to document the electronic crime scene
Understand how to testify as an expert witness
